correctness.rationale: For any unramified triple, the normal sequence is 0 -> O(2) -> O(4)^3 -> N -> 0 with entries the three binary quadratic Wronskians. The quotient N(-4) is globally generated of rank two and degree two, hence only O(1)^2 or O(0)+O(2). Serre duality gives h0(N(-6))=3-rank M, distinguishing these exactly, and unramifiedness forces rank M >=2. In characteristic two the middle coefficient of each Wronskian vanishes, forcing rank two. In odd characteristic disc W = 4 Res(P,Q) establishes two distinct ramification roots and a smooth surjective PGL2 bundle to the nonsingular binary-quadratic locus. The rank-two determinant hypersurface there is smooth and geometrically irreducible away from rank one, which is excluded by unramifiedness; its pullback has the same properties. Explicit uniform odd-characteristic rank-two and rank-three maps and a characteristic-two unramified map prove nonemptiness. The verifier checked exact witness identities, coprimeness, and rank for seven odd characteristics and characteristic two; all-characteristic statements are proven symbolically.

originality.rationale: Iwasaki arXiv:2609.39309, checked through its searchable primary HTML, with the relevant Sections 1, 3, 5 and 6 and the Section 6 worked example read, gives an encompassing cohomological framework and discusses characteristic-two phenomena, but does not calculate normal-bundle splitting or the scheme structure of the ramification-collinearity divisor for tridegree-(2,2,2) maps to a triple projective-line product. The present proof supplies this missing exact rank classification, identifies an irreducible smooth first jump divisor and exhibits a sharp characteristic-two collapse. The broader methods and abstract determinantal criterion are not claimed original. Searches and comparisons do not establish worldwide priority; equivalent old presentations are a residual risk.
residual_risks: Coordinate-equivalent older normal-splitting examples in product threefolds may not be indexed under the searched terminology.
Some general cohomological statements of Iwasaki contain rank-locus methods which could permit deduction of narrower pieces; no priority is asserted for those methods.
No independent priority search or mathematical audit has been performed.

value.rationale: This natural minimal symmetric tridegree family is the first in a threefactor product with three independently ramified projections. The theorem gives the entire normal splitting spectrum and a reduced, geometrically irreducible smooth first jump divisor with its explicit branch geometry and coefficient class, as well as a sharp, otherwise invisible collapse in characteristic two. Such normal splitting and jump loci are deformation invariants and directly answer the motivating current research question. The result is not only a routine matrix determinant or numerical instance: the global smoothness and irreducibility and all-characteristic classification are proved.
